summary: Whether the call creates a new image or edits an existing one.

usage.setIn: not set explicitly; the branch at openai-provider.ts:594 picks images.edit() when references exist and images.generate() otherwise
usage.code: const stream = hasReferences ? await this.client.images.edit({...}) : await this.client.images.generate({...})
usage.from: derived from whether the request carries reference images
usage.what: Chooses create against edit. Lixpi resolves this by calling two different endpoints rather than passing the tool's action field.
